blocks.text: Cell signalling cells ki woh salahiyat (ability) hai jis se woh apne mahol (environment) ke stimuli (asar dalne wali cheezon) ka jawab dete hain aur cell ke andar response (radd-e-amal) paida hota hai. Is mein cells ke darmiyan molecules ke ek silsile (series of molecular events) ke zariye signals bheje jate hain, jo aksar cell mein response tak le jate hain.
Steps of Cell Signalling (cell signalling ke marahil)

Cell signalling tab shuru hoti hai jab signal molecule (ligand) target cell ki membrane par lage receptor se jur jata hai. Yeh receptors aam taur par cell membrane mein jure proteins hote hain, lekin cell ke andar bhi ho sakte hain. Har receptor sirf ek khaas ligand ke liye hota hai, jaise taala sirf apni chaabi se khulta hai.

Jab receptor ligand se jurta hai to us ki shakal badal jati hai (conformational change). Is se cell ke andar ka signalling pathway (raasta) chalu (activate) ho jata hai. Is mein aksar kai molecules ek ke baad ek asar dalte aur badalte hain; is silsile ko signalling cascade kehte hain, aur yeh signal ko bara (amplify) kar deta hai. Chhote molecules jaise cAMP (cyclic AMP), calcium ions aur inositol triphosphate (IP₃) second messengers (doosre paigham-rasan) ka kaam karte hain: yeh signal ko receptor se cell ke andar target molecules tak pohanchate hain.

Signal transduction pathway aksar gene expression badal deta hai, yani kuch khaas genes on ya off ho jate hain. Is se cell mein kai responses ho sakte hain, jaise cell ka barhna (growth), division, differentiation (khaas kaam ka cell banna) ya apoptosis (programmed cell death, yani tay-shuda tareeqe se cell ki maut). Signalling se cell ka metabolism, enzymes ki activity, ya ion channels ka khulna aur band hona bhi badal sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Extracellular space mein cell membrane wala cell. 1 Signal reception: signal molecule (ligand) membrane ke receptor se jurta hai. 2 Signal transduction: intracellular pathway ke relay molecules signal aage pohanchate hain. 3 Cellular response: signal cytoplasm mein jawab (response) paida karta hai.

blocks.text: Pathways of Cell Signals from Outside to Inside (bahar se andar signal ke raste)

Cell signalling pathways signal ko cell ke bahar se andar tak pohanchate hain, jis se cell ka ek khaas response hota hai. Signalling pathways ki do bari qismein hain (signal molecule ki qisam ke mutabiq): protein/peptide signalling aur steroid signalling.

Protein ya peptide signal molecules water-soluble (pani mein ghulne wale) hain, is liye plasma membrane se guzar nahi sakte. Jab aisa ligand cell ki surface ke paas aata hai to plasma membrane par apne khaas receptor se jur jata hai. Is se receptor protein ki shakal badalti hai aur woh active ho jata hai. Active receptor cell ke andar reactions ka silsila shuru karta hai. In reactions se cyclic AMP (cAMP) jaisa second messenger banta hai jo tabdeeliyan shuru karta hai, jaise gene expression mein tabdeeli. Is pathway se metabolism, cell growth, division ya apoptosis mein tabdeeli aa sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Protein/peptide signalling teen hisson mein: extracellular space, cytoplasm aur nucleus. Signal reception: peptide signal plasma membrane ke receptor se jurta hai. Signal transduction: relay molecules signal aage dete hain aur second messenger use nucleus tak le jata hai. Cellular response: nucleus mein gene expression.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.32: Protein/peptide signalling ka raasta (textbook ki Figure 3.32 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peptide pani mein hal hone wala (water-soluble) hai, is liye membrane se nahin guzar sakta; woh bahar hi receptor se jurta hai aur andar ka kaam relay molecules aur second messenger (jaise cAMP) karte hain.

Steroid hormones lipophilic (charbi/lipid pasand) hain, is liye target cell ki plasma membrane se diffuse ho kar seedhe andar chale jate hain. Andar aa kar yeh cytoplasm ya nucleus mein maujood apne khaas intracellular (cell ke andar wale) receptors se jurte hain. Is se active receptor-hormone complex banta hai, jo agar pehle se nucleus mein na ho to nucleus mein chala jata hai. Nucleus mein yeh complex target genes ki khaas DNA sequences se jurta hai. Is se un genes ki transcription (DNA se RNA banna) control hoti hai, aur khaas proteins zyada ya kam banne lagte hain.

blocks.alt: Steroid signalling extracellular space, cytoplasm aur nucleus mein. Signal reception: steroid hormone signal plasma membrane ke paar aa jata hai. Signal transduction: cytoplasm mein receptor se jur kar receptor-hormone complex banata hai. Cellular response: complex nucleus mein ja kar gene expression badalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.33: Steroid signalling ka raasta (textbook ki Figure 3.33 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Steroid charbi pasand (lipophilic) hai, is liye seedha membrane se guzar jata hai; is ka receptor cell ke andar hai. Figure 3.32 se muqabla karein jahan receptor membrane par hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek signalling molecule lipid mein hal hone wala hai, jaise steroid hormone. Target cell mein us ke kaam karne ka sab se mumkin tareeqa kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh plasma membrane se diffuse hota hai, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein intracellular receptor se jurta hai, aur receptor-hormone complex khaas DNA sequences se jur kar transcription qaboo karta hai. Use membrane receptor ya second messengers ki zaroorat nahin.

items: Cell signalling: reception (ligand makhsoos receptor se jurta hai), transduction (receptor shakal badalta hai; cAMP, calcium ions aur IP₃ jaise second messengers wala cascade signal barhata hai) aur response (genes on ya off; numu, taqseem, differentiation, apoptosis, metabolism, ion channels).
Protein/peptide signals pani mein hal hone wale hain aur membrane receptors aur second messengers ke zariye kaam karte hain.
Steroid signals lipophilic hain, membrane se diffuse hote hain, intracellular receptors se jurte hain, aur complex nucleus mein transcription qaboo karta hai.
